Choose a palette

Source: vignettes/articles/palettes.Rmd
palettes.Rmd

Use the palette name as shown, for example carto_pal(5, "Burg") for hex codes or scale_fill_carto_c(palette = "Burg") for a continuous ggplot2 fill scale.

Preview palettes in R

Use display_carto_all() to see every palette or display_carto_all(colorblind_friendly = TRUE) to filter to palettes flagged as colorblind-friendly.
